text.content:
Heretical Splinter · Scattered, Persistent

A minority who keep writing anyway — not full transcriptions, which they agree are dangerous, but fragments, glosses, single lines jotted in the margins of unrelated books. Their argument: the disagreement everyone points to as evidence of corruption might just as easily be evidence the Outside is genuinely plural, and a partial written record, imperfect and contradictory, is still more than the silence the orthodox line risks losing to attrition and bad luck. The Unlettered consider the Marginalia's margin-notes exactly the kind of dabbling that produced the locked archive in the first place — small, deniable, and one bad copy away from becoming the next one.
